description: Tries a task's preview again when it stopped because of a problem on CodeGene's side (get_task or get_preview_links shows it stopped). It starts the same change again as it is, so nothing new is built or charged; CodeGene also tries again by itself for a day. Answers what happened in plain words: trying again (the preview usually shows up within a few minutes), nothing to try again, or not now and why. A preview that stopped because of something in the change itself needs a new request_change instead.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

task_id.description: The task whose preview to try again (list_tasks gives ids).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: retry_preview
title: Try a task's preview again
